datasets.name: Landslide4Sense dataset
datasets.source: IARAI (Institute of Advanced Research in Artificial Intelligence)
datasets.verbatim: The Landslide4Sense dataset is designed as a multi-source benchmark for training deep learning (DL) models in landslide detection [44,45]... The data is accessible on Future Development Leaderboard for future evaluation at https://github.com/iarai/Landslide4Sense-2022 (accessed on 30 December 2023) [45].

methods.name: SBConvU-Net
methods.summary: An improved U-Net architecture that integrates the Spatial and Band Refinement Convolution (SBConv) module into the DoubleConv units. The SBConv module, consisting of a Spatial Refined Unit (SRU) and a Band Refined Unit (BRU), is designed to reduce spatial and band redundancy in feature extraction.
methods.source: Song, Y.; Zou, Y.; Li, Y.; He, Y.; Wu, W.; Niu, R.; Xu, S.
methods.verbatim: The code of this article refers to https://github.com/cheng-haha/ScConv/tree/main (accessed on 31 December 2023) and https://github.com/iarai/Landslide4Sense-2022 (accessed on 31 December 2023).
